title: Model Predictive Control of a Multirotor UAV with a Cable-Suspended Payload: A Comparison of Shifted and Transformer-Based Warm Starts
abstract: arXiv:2611.33514v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This study investigates model predictive control (MPC) of a multirotor drone (unmanned aerial vehicle, UAV) carrying a cable-suspended payload, comparing conventional shifted initialization with Transformer-based warm starting of a sequential convex programming (SCP) optimizer. The controller uses a coupled mechanical model with an elastic cable and a double-pendulum representation of the suspended load. Its formulation includes move-blocked control inputs, finite-difference sensitivities, constrained quadratic subproblems, and input-feasibility projection. A Transformer trained on expert SCP solutions predicts an initial control sequence, which is subsequently refined by the same optimizer used for the conventional methods. Numerical experiments compare zero, shifted, and Transformer initialization under identical controller settings. translated_title: 具有缆绳吊挂载荷的多旋翼无人机的模型预测控制：移位初始化与基于Transformer的暖启动的比较
translated_abstract: 本研究研究了携带缆绳吊挂载荷的多旋翼无人机（无人驾驶飞行器，UAV）的模型预测控制（MPC），将传统的移位初始化与基于Transformer的暖启动在序列凸规划（SCP）优化器上进行了比较。该控制器采用带有弹性缆绳的耦合机械模型，并将吊挂载荷表示为双摆。其公式包含移动阻塞（move-blocked）控制输入、有限差分灵敏度、约束二次子问题以及输入可行性投影。一个在专家SCP解上训练的Transformer预测出初始控制序列，随后由与传统方法相同的优化器对其进行精炼。数值实验在相同的控制器设置下比较了零初始化、移位初始化和Transformer初始化。对于独立求解的MPC问题，Transformer初始化相对于移位初始化减少了计算时间……
tldr: 本文针对携带缆绳吊挂载荷的多旋翼无人机的模型预测控制，提出用基于Transformer的暖启动替代传统移位初始化来加速序列凸规划优化器，数值实验表明Transformer初始化能减少计算时间。
en_tdlr: For MPC of a multirotor UAV with a cable-suspended payload, this paper proposes a Transformer-based warm start for the sequential convex programming optimizer in place of conventional shifted initialization, and numerical experiments show that it reduces computation time.
